name: Launch Gate System
description: Structured launch gate and readiness decision matrix.
notes: Core launch asset for readiness decision-making.

name: Founder Alpha Readiness
description: Founder-only internal milestone for private testing and safety validation.

name: Founder Beta Readiness
description: Founder-only milestone for private beta validation and handoff readiness.
notes: Private Founder beta boundary before customer beta.

name: Customer Beta Readiness
description: Customer-facing beta deployment and qualification readiness.
notes: Requires customer consent and policy readiness.

name: Live-Trading Pilot Readiness
description: Readiness for a limited live-trading pilot under controlled conditions.
notes: Requires explicit broker and risk safety gating with deterministic and reconciliation evidence.

name: Billing and Subscription Readiness
description: Payment and entitlement test coverage is defined and verified.
notes: Billing and entitlement readiness evidence for commercial release.

name: Legal and Policy Readiness
description: Legal and customer-disclosure artifacts are drafted and tracked.
notes: Legal and policy readiness evidence for commercial release.

name: Support Operations Readiness
description: Support severity, escalation, incident, and recovery processes are documented.
notes: Support operations readiness evidence for commercial release.

name: Customer Communication Readiness
description: Waitlist, early-access, and customer messaging flows are defined.
notes: Customer communication readiness evidence for commercial release.

name: Rollback and Recovery Readiness
description: Rollback runbook and known-good recovery procedures are documented.
notes: Rollback readiness evidence for commercial release.

name: Commercial Release Readiness
description: Validated commercial release readiness including billing and operations.

name: Launch-Day Go/No-Go
description: Final launch day decision gate with rollback and monitoring readiness.
notes: Defines final authority and conditions for launch day.

name: Post-Launch Stabilization Exit
description: Post-launch stabilization and continued operation review.
notes: Defines criteria for exiting launch stabilization.
